home.title: Fleets
home.description: One isolated network per customer. Expand a fleet to see its machines.
home.search: Search a fleet or a machine…
home.notInPolicyHint: Machines carry this tag but no ACL rule exists for it: they have no access.
home.unassignedBanner: {count, plural, =1 {1 machine is waiting} other {# machines are waiting}} for a fleet.
home.noFleetHint: Create a customer fleet to open an isolated network for them.

fleet.summary: {total, plural, =0 {no machine} =1 {1 machine} other {# machines}} · {online} online
fleet.isolation: Isolated network: machines in this fleet only see each other. Stramatel support (internal fleet) can reach them; other customers never can.
fleet.isolationInternal: Stramatel support fleet: its machines can reach every customer fleet.
fleet.hypervisionDescription: The customer's stations that supervise their equipment.
fleet.equipmentDescription: Stramatel NUCs and Raspberry Pis installed at the customer site.
fleet.pendingKeys: {count, plural, =1 {1 key issued, not used yet} other {# keys issued, not used yet}}

inbox.title: To assign
inbox.description: Stramatel machines auto-enrolled at first boot. They have no access until they fill a slot in a fleet's plan (name, product and role).
inbox.emptyHint: Freshly flashed machines will show up here at first boot.
inbox.selected: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing selected} =1 {1 machine selected} other {# machines selected}}
inbox.assigned: {count, plural, =1 {1 machine assigned.} other {# machines assigned.}}
inbox.failed: {count, plural, =1 {1 machine could not be assigned.} other {# machines could not be assigned.}}
inbox.missingSlots: {count, plural, =1 {1 free slot is missing} other {# free slots are missing}} in this fleet's plan.
inbox.freeSlots: {count, plural, =0 {No free slot in the plan.} =1 {1 free slot in the plan.} other {# free slots in the plan.}}

machines.title: Machines
machines.description: The whole fleet park, across all fleets.
machines.staleHint: {count, plural, =1 {1 machine has been offline} other {# machines have been offline}} for more than {days} days: old records or removed machines? Click to show them.
machines.selected: {count, plural, =1 {1 machine selected} other {# machines selected}}
machines.bulkDone: {count, plural, =1 {1 machine processed.} other {# machines processed.}}
machines.bulkFailed: {count, plural, =1 {1 machine failed.} other {# machines failed.}}
machines.bulkDeleteWarning: The machine will be removed from the VPN. At a customer site, it can only come back with an on-site intervention (new key or reflash).

add.hypervisionIntro: The customer PC that supervises their equipment. It joins “{fleet}” with a single-use key you hand over, and only sees this fleet's machines.
add.equipmentIntro: Choose where the equipment to place in “{fleet}” comes from.
add.fromPendingHint: Auto-enrolled at the workshop, waiting in “To assign”.
add.fromKeyHint: Issue an equipment key to enter on the machine.
add.noPendingHint: A flashed machine shows up here at first boot. Otherwise, use a manual install.
add.renameHint: Lowercase, digits and dashes. Leave empty to keep the current name.

profile.title: Customer sheet
profile.empty: No information yet: add contact, site and job number to find them when the customer calls.
profile.editDescription: Information for fleet {tag}. The technical tag does not change.

search.hint: Type a fleet or machine name, an IP address, a serial or job number.

flow.title: Flows
flow.description: Who reaches whom in the fleet, on which ports, and live machine status. Plan slots not yet filled are dashed.
flow.note: Headscale does not measure volumes: allowed paths and status, not throughput.
flow.pickProduct: Pick a machine that carries a product.
flow.sameProduct: A product only reaches itself to link its SLAVEs to their server.
flow.pickTarget: Source: {name}. Click the target machine (the same source to link SLAVEs to their server).
flow.dialogDescription: The flow applies between these products in every fleet.

machine.packages: {count, plural, =0 {Packages} =1 {1 package installed} other {# packages installed}}
machine.updateSystem: {count, plural, =0 {System up to date} =1 {Update system (1)} other {Update system (#)}}
machine.requested: Update requested: the agent will pick it up within minutes.
machine.systemDescription: {count, plural, =1 {1 package} other {# packages}} of {os} will be updated by the machine's agent.
machine.systemWarning: Updates packages of the installed release (apt-get upgrade): no package removed, no OS version change. Some services may restart during the operation.
machine.noAgentHint: This device was joined without the agent: its specs, packages and updates are not known yet.
machine.installAgentHint: Run on the machine with sudo. The token only works for this machine; generating a new command invalidates the previous one.
machine.clientStationHint: This station belongs to the customer: Stramscale neither collects its inventory nor updates it.
machine.waitingInventoryHint: An install command was generated, but the agent has not reported yet. If it was not run on the machine, generate a new one: the old one will stop working.

vulns.title: Security faults
vulns.fixable: {count, plural, =0 {No fault fixed by an update} =1 {1 fault fixed by an available update} other {# faults fixed by available updates}}
vulns.unfixed: {count, plural, =0 {No unfixed fault} =1 {1 fault without a fix yet} other {# faults without a fix yet}}
vulns.hint: Recommended version: the latest one offered by the distribution, which fixes the listed faults. Click a package for details.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: What needs attention across the park.
dashboard.exposed: Exposed machines (fixable high or critical fault)
dashboard.updates: {machines, plural, =0 {Pending updates} =1 {Pending updates on 1 machine} other {Pending updates on # machines}}
dashboard.noFault: No fixable fault: the park is up to date.
dashboard.faultsHint: {machines, plural, =1 {On 1 machine.} other {On # machines.}} A fault present on several machines counts for each.
dashboard.noAgentTitle: {count, plural, =1 {1 device without agent} other {# devices without agent}}
dashboard.noAgentHint: Without an agent: no specs, faults or updates. Open the machine to generate the install command.
dashboard.noProductTitle: {count, plural, =1 {1 equipment without product} other {# equipment without product}}
dashboard.noProductHint: Every Stramatel machine must carry a product: open it to set one.

plan.title: Fleet plan
plan.description: What the fleet should contain. Each slot is filled by a key issued for it, or by assigning a pending machine.
plan.empty: No plan for this fleet yet. Prepare it: an SL TEMPO, an SL MEDIA and its SLAVEs, a supervision station… then issue keys or assign pending machines as installation goes.
plan.label: Label
plan.labelHint: The label also sets the machine's network name. Identical slots are numbered; an SL MEDIA's SLAVEs are named after it.
plan.keyDescription: The machine using it will take the slot's name, product and role.
plan.assignDescription: Machines waiting for assignment. It will take the slot's name, product and role.
plan.templateDescription: The template's slots are added to the existing plan.
plan.noTemplate: No template. Create one in Products and templates, or save a fleet's plan.
plan.saveDescription: Identical slots are grouped; machines are not kept.

product.label: Product
product.title: Machine product
product.description: Every Stramatel machine carries a product-line product, or a specific product created in the catalog. An SL MEDIA is a server, or a SLAVE attached to a server of the fleet.

catalog.title: Products and templates
catalog.description: The catalog of products set on machines, and templates to prepare a fleet in one click.
catalog.productsHint: Product-line and specific products. Names are editable.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.templatesHint: A typical layout (“Pool: SL TEMPO, SL MEDIA and 3 SLAVEs”) to apply to a fleet plan.
catalog.slavesHint: Its machines are then a server or a SLAVE attached to a server (SL MEDIA).
catalog.usedProduct: Used by machines: cannot be deleted
catalog.flowsHint: Who reaches whom, on which ports. Applies to every fleet; can also be set by clicking a fleet's diagram.
catalog.flowHint: Comma-separated ports, ranges with a dash (123, 8080-8090); empty = all. A product to itself: SLAVEs to their server.
